about.text: A semi-hard Dutch-type cheese, the most common round or brick cheese in the Czech Republic, made by about 15 Czech dairies. The curd is cut to pea-size grains, pressed and brined for 1 to 3 days, then ripened from 4 weeks to 10 to 15 months.
